description: Ordinary-assertion mutations for the registered zero boundaries of minimum sparse area, interlocking boundary avoidance, and filament toolchange delay.

mutants.description: Treat zero as promote-all. The exact boundary case “Minimum sparse area promotes only the analytically small component” must fail its ordinary REQUIRE `baseline.small_internal > 0`; the registered 0 mm² row must retain the analytically small internal component.

Treat explicit zero as the default value 2. The exact boundary case “Interlocking boundary avoidance changes outer geometry while preserving union” must fail both ordinary per-material CHECKs: `area_mm2(all_layer_symmetric_difference(..., 0)) > 0.01` and the corresponding region-1 assertion. Other interlocking cases selected by this CTest label remain controls.

Remove the zero-time early return so the exact case “WipeTower2 cooling delay appears as an independent wait command” emits a G4 at zero. Its new ordinary CHECK `cooling_park_motion(zero).find("G4") == std::string::npos` must fail; the 2-second G4 control and other selected tower cases remain controls.
